household.title: Household measurements
household.description: Select household HAN power and energy used this hour. EnergyTariff is recommended for its additional useful sensors. The optional hourly estimate may also come from Tibber or another integration. {validation_error}

data_description.han_power_entity: Select instantaneous household HAN power in W or kW.
data_description.tariff_used_entity: Select accumulated energy since the start of the current clock hour, in kWh. EnergyTariff is recommended; an equivalent Tibber sensor can also be used. Do not select a forecast, daily consumption or lifetime meter.
data_description.safety_margin_kwh: Subtracted from the available energy to allow for meter delay and changing household load.
data_description.energy_estimate_entity: Select estimated total energy for the current clock hour in kWh, e.g. EnergyTariff energy_estimate_this_hour or Tibber Estimated consumption current hour. Display only. If omitted, sensor.energy_estimate_this_hour is used when available.

planned.title: Planned features
planned.description: Hot-water tanks and floor heating are not supported yet. Floor heating is planned through Versatile Thermostat. No control is created here. Continue to return.

charging.title: EV charging
charging.description: Select the first Easee charger. Finish with one or add one more. Before setup, enable both Current (A) and Voltage (V) on each Easee charger: Settings → Devices & services → Easee → charger → Entities. Include disabled entities, enable both sensors and wait for measured values. {validation_error}

data_description.electrical_connection: Select the actual supply and wired phases, not the desired charging mode. Calculations use measured Easee voltage. Single-phase wiring hides the phase control.

second_charger.title: Second Easee charger
second_charger.description: The existing charger is retained. Select one new charger; only unused chargers are listed. At most two chargers are supported. Before setup, enable both Current (A) and Voltage (V) on each Easee charger: Settings → Devices & services → Easee → charger → Entities. Include disabled entities, enable both sensors and wait for measured values. {validation_error}
